Consolidated_Requirement: For any drowsiness, fatigue, or sleepiness claim, the verification specification SHOULD explicitly define the target state, reference/ground-truth method, rating scale or criterion, and temporal sampling/window used for evaluation.
Preconditions: Declared evaluation context and target state
Stimulus_or_Input: Apply the stated ground-truth procedure over the declared temporal window
Metric_or_Observable: Completeness and reproducibility of reference procedure
Procedure_or_Method: Protocol/document review plus independent application to evaluation data
Expected_Result: All required ground-truth elements are specified and reproducibly applicable
Acceptance_Boundary: DDAW-specific verification: KSS is the prescribed reference; warning is required at KSS-equivalent ≥8, with optional earlier warning at KSS 7. Alternative measures require evidence of equivalence to KSS 8. KSS measurement is approximately every 5 minutes; alternative video analysis has additional rater/concordance provisions.
Repetition_or_Sample_Condition: Repeat on an independent evaluation subset or by a second assessor where ratings are used
Evidence_Origin: EU Delegated Regulation 2021/1341, Annex I Part 1 §3.3.1; Part 2 §§5.1–5.3, 6.1
Uncertainty_or_Gap: Ground-truth validity remains construct-dependent

Consolidated_Requirement: A drowsiness/fatigue monitoring function using physiological indicators SHOULD validate each selected indicator against an explicitly defined reference state and relevant safety/performance evidence in the intended operating population and context.
Preconditions: Defined reference state and intended population/context
Stimulus_or_Input: Compare selected physiological indicator(s) with independent reference and safety/performance evidence
Metric_or_Observable: Association/discrimination plus robustness of indicator-state relationship
Expected_Result: Indicator demonstrates a stable, interpretable relationship with the defined state and relevant performance evidence
Acceptance_Boundary: For DDAW validation, alternative direct-state measures such as EEG/PERCLOS are permitted only under the regulation's conditions and require evidence of validity/accuracy and threshold equivalence to the prescribed KSS level.
Repetition_or_Sample_Condition: Use repeated conditions/participants sufficient to assess variability
Evidence_Origin: EU Delegated Regulation 2021/1341, Annex I Part 2 §5.2
Uncertainty_or_Gap: Metric-specific boundary requires source/system justification

Consolidated_Requirement: A drowsiness/fatigue monitoring function SHOULD demonstrate that its monitored state or intervention is meaningfully related to safety-relevant driving performance, capability, or outcomes under the conditions for which the claim is made.
Preconditions: Defined state and safety-relevant performance outcome
Stimulus_or_Input: Compare monitored state/intervention with driving capability/performance/outcome
Procedure_or_Method: Controlled, simulator, naturalistic, or on-road validation appropriate to claim
Expected_Result: Claimed state/intervention is supported by safety-relevant performance evidence
Acceptance_Boundary: DDAW validation must demonstrate accurate, robust and scientifically valid monitoring using the prescribed validation framework; warning events are evaluated against the reference drowsiness state and documented statistical results.
Evidence_Origin: EU Delegated Regulation 2021/1341, Annex I Part 2 §§1.1, 5.1, 8; Part 3 documentation
Uncertainty_or_Gap: Causal interpretation depends on study design

Consolidated_Requirement: A visual-distraction monitoring function SHOULD validate its gaze/off-road-glance indicators against safety-relevant driver behavior or performance across representative task and roadway conditions before using them for operational interpretation or warning.
Preconditions: Defined gaze/off-road-glance construct and task context
Stimulus_or_Input: Measure indicator and independent safety-relevant behavior/performance
Expected_Result: Indicator corresponds to independent distraction/performance evidence in intended context
Acceptance_Boundary: Euro NCAP provides source-prescribed DSM assessment/test conditions for transient visual-distraction states. Apply its exact movement/state/test criteria only when making an Euro NCAP assessment claim.
Evidence_Origin: Euro NCAP Driver Engagement v1.2 / SD-202 v1.2 (assessment scope)
Uncertainty_or_Gap: Operational thresholds must retain source provenance

CR_Theme: Cognitive distraction, inattention, and mind-wandering validity
Consolidated_Requirement: A monitoring function for cognitive distraction, inattention, or mind wandering SHOULD define the monitored construct and validate its indicators against independent behavioral, visual, or driving-performance evidence rather than relying on a single self-report or proxy.
Preconditions: Explicit construct definition and independent comparator
Stimulus_or_Input: Compare monitoring indicators with independent behavioral/visual/performance evidence
Expected_Result: Interpretation is supported by more than a single self-report/proxy
Acceptance_Boundary: ADDW/assessment evidence supports attention/distraction monitoring, but the broader cognitive-distraction, inattention and mind-wandering construct in this CR exceeds the source-prescribed verification boundary.
Repetition_or_Sample_Condition: Across representative states/tasks and, where relevant, repeated observations
Evidence_Origin: EU GSR ADDW obligation + Euro NCAP transient-state assessment; current bounded sources do not prescribe a universal cognitive-distraction/mind-wandering ground truth
Uncertainty_or_Gap: Constructs are heterogeneous; avoid collapsing them without evidence

Consolidated_Requirement: A distraction-mitigation or feedback function SHOULD be evaluated for safety-relevant behavioral effect, attention recovery, usability/acceptance where relevant, and persistence or adaptation under representative interaction conditions.
Preconditions: Defined intervention, baseline/comparator, and intended task context
Stimulus_or_Input: Expose participants to intervention and comparator; measure attention, behavior, usability/acceptance and adaptation as applicable
Metric_or_Observable: Behavioral safety effect and intervention usability/adaptation
Expected_Result: Intervention produces the claimed safety-relevant behavioral effect without unsupported adverse adaptation
Acceptance_Boundary: For claimed distraction states, Euro NCAP prescribes warning/intervention assessment conditions. Use the applicable protocol's exact test conditions for an assessment claim.
Repetition_or_Sample_Condition: Repeated exposure where persistence/adaptation is claimed
Evidence_Origin: Euro NCAP Driver Engagement v1.2 / SD-202 v1.2 (assessment scope)
Uncertainty_or_Gap: Long-term persistence may require longitudinal evidence

Consolidated_Requirement: An attention-adaptive or collision-warning function SHOULD validate the attention-state interpretation, warning timing or adaptation logic, and resulting safety-relevant driver response in the intended operating context.
Preconditions: Defined attention interpretation, warning logic, hazard context
Stimulus_or_Input: Manipulate/observe attention and hazard conditions; measure warning timing and driver response
Expected_Result: Adaptation logic and resulting response support the claimed safety effect
Acceptance_Boundary: Current verified sources support warnings for monitored driver states but do not prescribe one universal verification rule for attention-adaptive or forward-collision-warning logic.
Uncertainty_or_Gap: FCW and DMS warning functions are not automatically equivalent

Consolidated_Requirement: A takeover-readiness or transition-support function SHOULD be validated across representative driver engagement, cognitive/task demand, hazard criticality, and transition conditions using observable safety-relevant takeover performance.
Preconditions: Defined automation state, TOR/failure scenario and performance outcomes
Stimulus_or_Input: Vary engagement/task demand/hazard criticality; measure takeover response
Metric_or_Observable: Takeover time, control quality, hazard response and related observables as defined by study
Expected_Result: Function supports the claimed readiness/transition interpretation across declared conditions
Acceptance_Boundary: No universal takeover-time boundary justified by current corpus
Repetition_or_Sample_Condition: Multiple transition scenarios and relevant driver states
Uncertainty_or_Gap: No direct binding P1–P3 anchor

Consolidated_Requirement: A driver-engagement function for automated driving SHOULD validate its indicators across relevant automation levels, driving experience, traffic demand, and non-driving-task conditions, and SHOULD avoid treating self-reported trust as equivalent to safe engagement.
Preconditions: Defined automation level, trust/engagement constructs and task context
Stimulus_or_Input: Compare indicator with independent monitoring behavior/performance across contexts
Expected_Result: Indicator supports engagement interpretation without equating self-reported trust with safe engagement
Acceptance_Boundary: No universal boundary justified
Uncertainty_or_Gap: Trust and engagement require separate operational definitions

Consolidated_Requirement: A mental-workload monitoring function SHOULD validate its indicators against the defined workload construct across representative task, traffic, and automation conditions and account for contextual factors that can produce similar signal changes.
Preconditions: Explicit workload construct and comparator
Stimulus_or_Input: Vary task/traffic/automation demand and compare indicators with independent workload/performance evidence
Metric_or_Observable: Construct sensitivity, specificity to workload versus contextual confounds
Expected_Result: Indicator changes consistently with defined workload while contextual alternatives are assessed
Acceptance_Boundary: No universal workload threshold justified
Uncertainty_or_Gap: Workload construct and measurement method vary

Consolidated_Requirement: A driver-stress monitoring or feedback function SHOULD define the stress outcome and evaluate its indicators or intervention effect across the driving modes and contexts for which the claim is made.
Preconditions: Defined stress outcome and driving context
Stimulus_or_Input: Compare indicators/intervention with independent stress measures and driving outcomes
Metric_or_Observable: Stress construct validity or intervention effect
Expected_Result: Claimed stress interpretation/effect is supported in declared driving modes/contexts
Acceptance_Boundary: No universal stress threshold justified
Repetition_or_Sample_Condition: Across relevant contexts; repeated exposure if mitigation persistence claimed
Uncertainty_or_Gap: Exploratory evidence may limit generalization

Consolidated_Requirement: An impairment-monitoring function SHOULD distinguish plausible overlapping causes of observed indicators and validate claimed impairment interpretations against independent safety-relevant evidence across relevant temporal and operating conditions.
Preconditions: Defined impairment claim, alternative causes and independent comparator
Stimulus_or_Input: Compare indicators across impairment and plausible overlapping states; measure safety-relevant performance
Expected_Result: Claimed impairment interpretation distinguishes relevant alternatives sufficiently for its stated use
Acceptance_Boundary: No legal/clinical impairment threshold inferred from empirical corpus
Repetition_or_Sample_Condition: Across relevant temporal and operating conditions
Uncertainty_or_Gap: Medical/legal classification requires external authority

Consolidated_Requirement: A situation-awareness monitoring function SHOULD establish construct validity for each selected indicator or modality and demonstrate that any multimodal combination adds meaningful information in the intended automation context.
Preconditions: Explicit situation-awareness construct
Stimulus_or_Input: Compare each modality and fused output with independent SA reference/performance
Metric_or_Observable: Construct validity and incremental multimodal value
Expected_Result: Each retained modality contributes defensible information and fusion adds value if claimed
Acceptance_Boundary: No universal boundary justified
Uncertainty_or_Gap: Single-source evidence base

Consolidated_Requirement: A risk-perception monitoring function SHOULD validate the relationship between its selected indicators and the defined risk-perception construct across relevant hazards, activities, and contexts before safety-related use.
Preconditions: Explicit risk-perception construct and hazards
Stimulus_or_Input: Compare indicators with independent subjective/behavioral risk evidence
Expected_Result: Indicator supports claimed risk-perception interpretation across declared contexts
Acceptance_Boundary: No universal boundary justified
Uncertainty_or_Gap: Single-theme evidence and context dependence

Consolidated_Requirement: A physiological human-state monitoring function SHOULD establish that selected physiological measures are sensitive to the intended construct and robust to relevant confounding physiological, environmental, and operational influences.
Preconditions: Defined target construct and confound set
Stimulus_or_Input: Manipulate/observe target state and confounds; compare signal response
Metric_or_Observable: Sensitivity to construct and robustness to confounds
Expected_Result: Measure responds to intended construct and remains interpretable under relevant confounds
Acceptance_Boundary: No universal metric threshold justified
Repetition_or_Sample_Condition: Across participants and relevant environmental/physiological conditions
Uncertainty_or_Gap: General physiological validity depends on modality

Consolidated_Requirement: When multiple modalities or information sources are combined, the monitoring function SHOULD demonstrate the incremental or complementary validity of each source for the intended state or safety outcome rather than assuming that fusion is inherently superior.
Preconditions: Defined modalities, target state/outcome and baseline models
Stimulus_or_Input: Evaluate each source alone and combined under same validation data
Procedure_or_Method: Ablation or nested-model comparison plus safety-relevant validation
Expected_Result: Combined system demonstrates added information/value beyond justified constituent sources when fusion is claimed
Acceptance_Boundary: No universal improvement percentage required
Uncertainty_or_Gap: Added value can be statistical, operational or safety-relevant but must be pre-defined

Consolidated_Requirement: A human-state monitoring function SHOULD evaluate inter-individual variability in indicator-to-state relationships and justify whether population-level interpretation, individualized calibration, or personalization is appropriate.
Preconditions: Defined target state and population
Stimulus_or_Input: Estimate performance/relationship by individual or relevant strata; compare population versus individualized interpretation
Expected_Result: Variability is quantified and chosen calibration/personalization strategy is justified by observed evidence
Acceptance_Boundary: No universal variability threshold required
Uncertainty_or_Gap: Personalization may introduce data/privacy and deployment costs not evaluated here

Consolidated_Requirement: A human-state monitoring function SHOULD identify and evaluate operational, roadway, environmental, temporal, or traffic contexts that materially change the interpretation of monitored indicators or safety-relevant responses.
Preconditions: Predefined operational/road/environment/time/traffic contexts
Stimulus_or_Input: Evaluate same indicator/state relationship across contexts
Procedure_or_Method: Stratified scenario, naturalistic, or on-road validation
Expected_Result: Material context effects are identified and incorporated into applicability/interpretation
Acceptance_Boundary: For DDAW, source-prescribed operating conditions include day/night operation and defined roadway/environmental applicability; validation documentation must address known limitations and system behavior.
Evidence_Origin: EU Delegated Regulation 2021/1341, Annex I Part 1 §3.2; Part 2 environmental/test provisions
Uncertainty_or_Gap: Context coverage must match claimed ODD/use domain

Consolidated_Requirement: A human-state monitoring function SHOULD validate its claimed interpretation in the populations for which it is intended and SHOULD explicitly bound generalization when age, experience, health, demographic, or other population characteristics may alter the relationship.
Preconditions: Predefined intended population and relevant strata
Stimulus_or_Input: Evaluate state/indicator performance across target population strata
Metric_or_Observable: Performance/validity by population subgroup and generalization boundary
Expected_Result: Claimed interpretation is supported in intended groups and unsupported extrapolation is explicitly bounded
Acceptance_Boundary: No universal subgroup-equivalence threshold inferred
Uncertainty_or_Gap: Fairness/equivalence thresholds require separate normative decision

Consolidated_Requirement: When a monitoring claim concerns older drivers, validation SHOULD emphasize relevant functional capability and variability rather than using chronological age or a single clinical/visual measure as a proxy for driving capability.
Preconditions: Define relevant functional capabilities; do not use age alone as construct
Stimulus_or_Input: Compare monitoring interpretation with functional and safety-relevant outcomes
Metric_or_Observable: Functional validity beyond chronological age/single proxy
Expected_Result: Claim is supported by relevant functional evidence and is not based solely on chronological age
Acceptance_Boundary: No universal age/function cutoff inferred
Uncertainty_or_Gap: Clinical screening thresholds are outside current evidence authority

Consolidated_Requirement: When a monitoring claim concerns young or novice drivers, validation SHOULD account for relevant experience, developmental/contextual factors, and co-occurring risk behaviors that can alter the claimed state-to-safety relationship.
Preconditions: Define experience/developmental/context factors and outcome
Stimulus_or_Input: Evaluate interpretation across relevant experience/context and co-occurring behaviors
Expected_Result: Claimed relationship is demonstrated in target novice population with relevant confounds considered
Acceptance_Boundary: No universal boundary justified
Uncertainty_or_Gap: Limited evidence volume after consolidation

Consolidated_Requirement: When a monitoring claim concerns professional or occupational drivers, validation SHOULD reflect representative work schedules, time-on-task, roadway/route conditions, and other occupational factors relevant to the claimed fatigue, distraction, or safety interpretation.
Preconditions: Define work schedule/time-on-task/route/occupational conditions
Stimulus_or_Input: Evaluate indicator-state relationship across representative occupational conditions
Expected_Result: Claim is supported across the occupational conditions included in its stated scope
Acceptance_Boundary: No universal work-hour/fatigue threshold inferred
Uncertainty_or_Gap: Regulatory hours-of-service requirements are external to current bounded audit

Consolidated_Requirement: A driver alert or warning SHOULD be evaluated for perceivability, comprehension, directional/action clarity where applicable, and safety-relevant response under representative cognitive, sensory, and demographic conditions.
Preconditions: Defined alert, required action, user groups and sensory/cognitive contexts
Stimulus_or_Input: Present alert under representative conditions; measure detection, comprehension and safety-relevant response
Expected_Result: Users can perceive and correctly interpret the required action and produce the intended safety-relevant response under declared conditions
Acceptance_Boundary: For DDAW, the system must alert through the HMI at the prescribed drowsiness boundary. Euro NCAP additionally supplies assessment-scoped warning/intervention conditions for claimed DSM states.
Evidence_Origin: EU Delegated Regulation 2021/1341, Annex I Part 1 §§2.1, 3.3.1; Euro NCAP Driver Engagement/SD-202
Uncertainty_or_Gap: Acceptance is not identical to safety effectiveness

Consolidated_Requirement: A driver-support or monitoring intervention SHOULD be evaluated for behavioral adaptation, reliance, acceptance/engagement where relevant, and unintended changes that could modify its safety effect over repeated use.
Preconditions: Defined intervention and baseline; repeated-use claim if applicable
Stimulus_or_Input: Compare behavior across initial and repeated exposure
Expected_Result: No material adaptation or reliance pattern contradicts the claimed safety benefit
Acceptance_Boundary: No universal adaptation boundary justified
Repetition_or_Sample_Condition: Repeated exposure required when adaptation/persistence is claimed
Uncertainty_or_Gap: Long-term field evidence may be required

Consolidated_Requirement: A monitoring or support function that claims a safety benefit SHOULD demonstrate both valid detection/interpretation of its target condition and a defensible relationship between that condition, the expected response, and relevant safety-performance outcomes.
Preconditions: Explicit target condition, expected system/driver response and safety outcome
Stimulus_or_Input: Test detection/interpretation and downstream response/outcome in linked scenarios
Metric_or_Observable: End-to-end trace from condition to response to safety outcome
Expected_Result: Both target-condition interpretation and claimed mitigation pathway are evidenced; failure of either prevents claiming the end-to-end safety benefit
Acceptance_Boundary: Acceptance boundary must be defined for the specific safety claim; corpus supplies no universal value
Repetition_or_Sample_Condition: Across representative scenarios and failure cases
Uncertainty_or_Gap: Causal strength depends on evaluation design

Consolidated_Requirement: Each monitored human-state or behavior claim SHOULD explicitly define the construct, population/context, and scope of interpretation, and SHOULD avoid extending the claim beyond what the supporting evidence can justify.
Preconditions: Before validation, declare construct, population, context and interpretation limits
Stimulus_or_Input: Audit requirement/claim and linked evidence for scope consistency
Expected_Result: Every operational claim is linked to a defined construct and evidence applicable to its population/context; unsupported extrapolation is flagged
Acceptance_Boundary: Binary completeness/traceability criterion can be project-defined without adding substantive state threshold
Evidence_Origin: Derived from traceability chain and empirical scope evidence
Uncertainty_or_Gap: Does not itself establish clinical/scientific validity

Consolidated_Requirement: A human-state monitoring function SHOULD assess whether findings from simulation, controlled experiments, or restricted samples generalize to representative real-vehicle/on-road conditions before making operational safety claims.
Preconditions: Existing controlled/simulator evidence and defined deployment claim
Stimulus_or_Input: Replicate/evaluate under representative real-vehicle/on-road conditions or justify why not required
Expected_Result: Operational safety claim is supported in representative deployment conditions or explicitly restricted to validated conditions
Acceptance_Boundary: DDAW is required to minimize system error under real driving conditions, and the regulation prescribes human-participant/behavior-data validation with safety backup for real-world road tests.
Evidence_Origin: EU Delegated Regulation 2021/1341, Annex I Part 1 §2.2 and Part 2 validation provisions
Uncertainty_or_Gap: Some constructs may require staged validation for safety/ethics

Consolidated_Requirement: A sensing or measurement function SHOULD validate signal quality and state-estimation robustness under representative environmental, motion, placement/configuration, and other operating limitations relevant to deployment.
Preconditions: Defined deployment limitations: environment, motion, placement/configuration and signal-quality conditions
Stimulus_or_Input: Exercise sensing under representative limitation combinations
Metric_or_Observable: Signal quality, availability, measurement error/state-estimation robustness
Expected_Result: Measurement remains fit for the claimed interpretation under declared operating limits; unsupported conditions are bounded
Acceptance_Boundary: DDAW must minimize system error under real driving conditions and document known/logical limitations and system behavior under relevant environmental challenges.
Repetition_or_Sample_Condition: Across representative limitation combinations and repeated trials
Evidence_Origin: EU Delegated Regulation 2021/1341, Annex I Part 1 §§2.2, 3.2; Part 3 limitations documentation
Uncertainty_or_Gap: Specific sensor standards may provide stronger boundaries later
